lines.text: Many learners say: Let's do shopping today.

native.tip: 한국어는 “쇼핑하다”처럼 명사에 “하다”를 붙여서 do를 쓰기 쉬워요. 영어는 쇼핑하러 갈 땐 go shopping이에요!
native.caption: “Let's do shopping today.”라고 말하고 있나요? 😅 한국어 “쇼핑하다”처럼 명사에 “하다”를 붙이면 do shopping이 돼요. 영어는 go shopping이라고 해요. “Let's go shopping today”가 맞아요. Ama 선생님을 따라 말해 보세요! Lexkite 앱에서 더 연습해요.
native.comment: 정답: “go”. go shopping으로 외워요! 무료 퀴즈로 더 연습해 보세요: {link}

en.tip: Korean makes verbs with hada, so people say do shopping. English says go shopping. Say “Let's go shopping today”.
en.caption: Do you say “Let's do shopping today”? 😅 We say go shopping, not do shopping. “Let's go shopping today” is right. Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
